catalog.name: entity:repair.order
catalog.description: Complete definition of entity Repair Order (repair.order).

fields.name: state
fields.help:
* The 'New' status is used when a user is encoding a new and unconfirmed repair order.
* The 'Confirmed' status is used when a user confirms the repair order.
* The 'Under Repair' status is used when the repair is ongoing.
* The 'Repaired' status is set when repairing is completed.
* The 'Cancelled' status is used when user cancel repair order.
